Current source: each group card's label button and its Name this person / Edit label control open the existing inline naming editor; that naming action is the media row's primary. The thumbnail (ClusterPreview) is noninteractive, and no chip-to-review or chip-to-workspace navigation exists.

UXREC-1 IDENTITY (proposed): a new projection buildRepeatedRegionEvidence reads the row's raw DetectedIdentity records before groupIdentitiesByClusters de-duplicates within a group. It reports a repeated region only for the same positive media_id with exactly equal finite x, y, width and height (x and y at least 0, width and height above 1) under two or more different group keys (person:<id>, else cluster:<id>, else ungrouped), using one shared group-key helper so grouping and evidence cannot drift. No IoU or similarity threshold, cross-photo content match, automatic merge or transitive grouping ([GRPH-18] Never trust the transitive closure of a raw similarity threshold, Introduction to Information Retrieval, § 17.2).

UXREC-1 evidence is text in an in-place native details disclosure on the group card or Not yet grouped section: Photo <media_id>, the region, each identity_id with its group ref, and the row pool line Checked M of N loaded face records with usable box coordinates ([VIZ-23] Show the evidence path, Richard Feynman's Mental Models, ch. 5 + Envisioning Information, ch. 4). N counts each unique non-empty identity_id loaded for this row once; M counts those with usable box coordinates whose loaded copies agree. An identity_id whose loaded copies disagree is excluded from M and from every region and appears only in the skipped count. There is no overall group total, source title, hash, corpus total or completeness field. No evidence image is added; [VIZ-41] Reveal the image-selection pool, Visual Explanations, ch. 1, would apply only if a selected image were later offered as consequential evidence. Matching coordinates are not identity truth or detector repair. The operator's statement that the supplied Emma crops show one person stays supplied ground truth, not a new identification.

UXREC-1 new summary, pool and skipped-record human-count display (proposed, not implemented): Use the verified WordPress admin HTML publisher, document.documentElement.lang, for these admin-control counts, not a per-post content-generation language. Supplied primary WordPress 7.1.3 core evidence traces admin-header.php to wp-admin/includes/template.php:_wp_admin_html_begin, which calls language_attributes(), then wp-includes/general-template.php:get_language_attributes() and get_bloginfo('language'), with the language_attributes filter publishing the HTML attributes. get_bloginfo uses the html_lang_attribute translation or determine_locale() with underscores replaced by hyphens; the published value still needs validation. At the display boundary, validate a non-empty BCP47 UI locale and runtime number-format support before explicitly passing that locale to Intl.NumberFormat. Missing, malformed or unsupported host locale, or unavailable/failing Intl, uses a deliberate non-throwing neutral raw-numeric fallback (String(count), no grouping), never claimed localized. Never assume English, use navigator.language or pass undefined to Intl. Keep the original numeric counts for _n plural selection, comparisons, accounting and predicates; only human display slots become strings. Gettext arguments remain literals in domain alt-context; Admin::enqueue_entry already calls wp_set_script_translations, which is separate from number formatting and proves no translation-bundle or deployed readiness. No service/request/schema locale field, shared formatter dependency or whole-app locale plumbing is added. Implementation symbols belong to the task plan. Canon v0.26.2 [REF-27] Don't program by coincidence, Source: The Pragmatic Programmer, ch. 7; https://github.com/darce/heuristics-canon.

Proposed repeated-region details (native details and summary, in place): shown only on a group card or the Not yet grouped section that lists an exact repeated photo region. Summary uses _n('Same photo region is also listed in %s other group', 'Same photo region is also listed in %s other groups', n, 'alt-context'), where raw numeric n counts only the other group keys that share this card's regions; the %s display slot is locale-formatted under the verified host-UI-locale contract. Expanded text: the exact-coordinates limit statement; Photo <media_id>, region x, y, width, height, and each identity_id with its group ref; then the row pool line uses _n('Checked %1$s of %2$s loaded face record with usable box coordinates.', 'Checked %1$s of %2$s loaded face records with usable box coordinates.', loadedObservationCount, 'alt-context'). The raw numeric loadedObservationCount selects plural forms even if English singular is unreachable; %2$s displays locale-formatted N, the unique non-empty identity_id values loaded for this row, and %1$s displays locale-formatted M, those with usable box coordinates whose loaded copies agree. Only when one or more identity_ids have loaded copies that disagree (media_id, group key, person_id, cluster_id or box) does the skipped line follow: _n('%s face record was skipped because its loaded copies disagree.', '%s face records were skipped because their loaded copies disagree.', skippedCount, 'alt-context'), with raw numeric skippedCount = abstainedIdentityIds.length selecting plural forms and only the %s display slot locale-formatted. A skipped identity_id counts once in N, never in M or a region. No overall group total. Photo <media_id>, raw bbox numbers, identity_id and person/face-group refs stay canonical and inspectable, outside this human-count formatting. The thumbnail is context only; no new crop, image, title, merge or naming change. empty = no repeated region, nothing rendered; degraded = M below N (unusable box coordinates or skipped records).
